scope: 10k model-only performance optimization; not a causal 5k/10k ablation
checkpoint_policy: save each equivalent epoch, evaluate every2 immediately before the next training segment; successful updates only

selection.primary: maximum complete-dev mask AP across new checkpoints and cached C5k20k
selection.tie: keep cached baseline on a cross-run tie; earlier update within the new run
selection.protocol: fixed dev250/1008GT, upstream_instance, 800/1333, top100, FP32, no score threshold
selection.baseline_comparison: separate same-evaluation cross-run comparison; never bypass strict within-run training identity checks

stopping.improvement_definition: complete-dev AP strictly exceeds incumbent baseline/new best
stopping.on_failure: stop; retain last complete checkpoint and failed-run logs
